class.name: OcgTransferActordispatch
class.brief_description: This class allows to work with a TransferDispatch, i.e. to transfer entities from a data set to another one defined by the same interface norm, with the following features : - ActorDispatch itself acts as a default actor, i.e. it copies entities with the general service Copy, as CopyTool does - it allows to add other actors for specific ways of transfer, which may include data modifications, conversions ... - and other features from TransferDispatch (such as mapping other than one-one)

method.name: TransferDispatch
method.description: Returns the TransferDispatch, which does the work, records the intermediate data, etc... See TransferDispatch & CopyTool, to see the available methods

method.name: Transfer
method.description: Specific action : it calls the method Transfer from CopyTool i.e. the general service Copy, then returns the Binder produced by the TransientProcess
